## Define data and outcomes

```{r, echo=T}



meta.long<- meta.long.pa %>%
  dplyr::filter(time !=18)

outcomes<- c('outcome_wt_fnl','wc_average', 'WBTOT_FAT','HOMA_IR','Hemoglobin_A1C')


```


## LME models

```{r, echo=T}
           
## example running lmer mixed effects model on one outcome

mod.single.out<- lmer(outcome_wt_fnl~ age_scale+sex+imf+race_cat3+hispanic+time + (1| subject_id), data = meta.long, REML = FALSE) %>%
  tidy(., effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)
## using purr

models<- meta.long %>%
  dplyr::select(outcomes) %>%
  purrr::map(~ lmer(.x ~exposure_var+ age_scale+sex+imf+race_cat3+hispanic+time + (1| subject_id), data = meta.long, REML = FALSE)) %>%
  purrr::map(~tidy(., effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE))

models.exposure<-  as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, models))  %>%
  dplyr::filter(term=='exposure_var') %>%
  dplyr::rename(exposure=term)%>%
  mutate(fdr=p.adjust(p.value, method='fdr'))%>%
  mutate(outcome=outcomes)%>%
  dplyr::select(-effect) %>%
  relocate(outcome)

```





## Output results

```{r}

fwrite(models.exposure,      file='/Users/stanislm/Documents/BIPM/K01/Output/Outcomes_LME/LME_exposure_date.csv')

save(models.exposure,      file='/Users/stanislm/Documents/BIPM/K01/Output/Outcomes_LME/LME_exposure_date.RData')
```
